_method_version: 1.0.0 promotes five figures from a fourteen-figure workspace recipe, chosen because together they are one method rather than five findings: the register is mostly sampling effort, a within-stratum composition ratio divides that out, and the result is a biological cliff that survives every check thrown at it. Two of the five replace published versions kept in the workspace rather than deleted — a pair of figures that made the same argument twice and named the same cells twice, merged into one, and a depth panel whose reader could not tell what was being compared because the comparison was drawn as three separate hairline rules.

source.publisher: OBIS, the Ocean Biodiversity Information System
source.note: Live and additive. The record count moved by 62,000 between two probes minutes apart, so every figure is a statement about one fetch.
